title.narrative: SURGE: Scale-up Roadmap for Growing Enterprises

description.narrative: The Scale-up Roadmap for Growing Enterprises Program (SURGE) has been designed to helps existing innovative high growth potential enterprises to grow and scale. The main objective is to foster the demand-driven growth and scaling of innovative companies, in particular SMEs, by assisting them to identify and seize market opportunities.
